correctness.rationale: The standard Minkowski sum has M=2^n-1 and total coordinate sum M. The published proper-tube facet classification gives singleton offsets zero and a hub-containing k-tube offset 2^(k-1)-1. Intrinsic projected singleton normals have squared norm n/(n+1). Summing the n+1 singleton ball constraints yields r<=M/sqrt(n(n+1)) and equality forces c=M/(n+1) times the all-ones vector. For k>=2, the tube-normal squared norm is k(n+1-k)/(n+1), and F(j)=(2^(j-1)-1)/(j(j-1)) is nondecreasing because F(j+1)-F(j)=((j-3)2^(j-1)+2)/(j(j-1)(j+1))>=0. This yields normalized tube slack >=k(N-k)/(N-1)>=sqrt(k(N-k)/(N-1)), proving candidate ball feasible. Equality for a non-singleton requires n=2,k=2. The inspected actual Git tree SHA was independently rebuilt from all seven blob SHAs, and exact rational tube-distance checks n=2..80 confirm the equality pattern as corroboration only.
